technical_and_design_decisions: Use Java 17 and JUnit 5 as the foundational test framework standard across all acceptance test suites.
Utilize Testcontainers and Spring Boot test utilities to spin up isolated containerized environments for integration and acceptance testing.
Implement wiremocks or lightweight container instances for external services such as Splunk and Spark.
Integrate test suites directly into the CI pipeline (e.g., GitHub Actions / Jenkins) with dedicated matrix/parallel test jobs to prevent build bottlenecks.
assumptions: The sink modules and batch job applications are fully developed, functional, and ready for acceptance test coverage.
CI build agents support running Docker/Testcontainers required for running acceptance tests.
Test datasets and expected outputs for batch jobs and sink modules are documented or easily identifiable.

activities.activity_name: Test Environment Setup & Base Framework Configuration
activities.activity_description: Configure the base acceptance testing harness, helper utilities, and container setup required for running sink and batch job acceptance tests in local and CI environments.

activities.activity_name: Acceptance Tests for Null Sink Module (U1)
activities.activity_description: Develop automated acceptance tests validating message consumption and drop behavior for the null sink module, ensuring zero side-effects.

activities.activity_name: Acceptance Tests for Rich Gauge Sink Module (U2)
activities.activity_description: Develop acceptance tests for the rich_gauge sink module, validating metric publishing and gauge recording functionality.

activities.activity_name: Acceptance Tests for Router Sink Module (U3)
activities.activity_description: Develop acceptance tests for the router sink module, verifying message routing logic based on payload content and evaluation headers.

activities.activity_name: Acceptance Tests for Shell Sink Module (U4)
activities.activity_description: Develop acceptance tests for the shell sink module, verifying command execution, argument handling, and system process invocation.

activities.activity_name: Acceptance Tests for Splunk Sink Module (U5)
activities.activity_description: Develop acceptance tests for the splunk sink module using a mocked/containerized Splunk HTTP Event Collector (HEC) endpoint to verify event publishing.

activities.activity_name: Acceptance Tests for Throughput-Sampler Sink Module (U6)
activities.activity_description: Develop acceptance tests for the throughput-sampler sink module, verifying message throughput counting and periodic sampling log output.

activities.activity_name: Acceptance Tests for Spark-App Batch Job (U7)
activities.activity_description: Develop acceptance tests for the spark-app batch task, verifying execution initiation, parameter propagation, and job status reporting.

activities.activity_name: Acceptance Tests for Timestampfile Batch Job (U8)
activities.activity_description: Develop acceptance tests for the timestampfile batch task, verifying file creation, output directory handling, and accurate timestamp writing.
Integrate all newly created acceptance test suites into the continuous integration (CI) pipeline, ensuring robust, non-flaky execution on every build.
